title: Day 777: Gunmen Ambush Federal Protection Force Patrol on Highway Mexico 15; Four Captured
detail: Armed men opened fire on a Federal Protection Force (SPF) patrol conducting security operations on federal Highway Mexico 15 near Jesús María, Culiacán, on September 8, 2026. Agents repelled the attack and captured four suspects without sustaining injuries. Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch said the detainees were linked to vehicle theft and were suspected of generating violence in Culiacán and surrounding municipalities. Agents seized three firearms (two long guns, one handgun), 30 magazines, 502 cartridges, five ballistic vests, two tactical chest plates, metal spike strips (ponchallantas), and a vehicle with Texas plates reported stolen in the United States.

title: Day 777: Wave of Shootings and Vehicle Fires Hits Multiple Culiacán Neighborhoods Overnight
detail: Starting around 7:30 PM on September 8, 2026, near-simultaneous violent incidents were reported across at least three sectors of Culiacán: gunfire at the intersection of Avenida Patria and México 68; a vehicle rammed into a home's gate and set ablaze on Baltasar Izaguirre Rojo street in the Chapultepec neighborhood, damaging the garage; and gunfire on Rubén Martí street in the Gustavo Díaz Ordaz sector following a vehicle theft. Roughly 60 shell casings were recovered at one scene, and several homes were struck by gunfire. The state Interinstitutional Group and Mexican Army units deployed to the affected areas; Sinaloa's Public Security Secretariat said no deaths or injuries had been reported and urged residents to avoid the affected zones and rely only on official channels for information. Separately, a woman was detained in Concordia with a rifle, three magazines and 90 rounds of ammunition, and a 28-year-old man detained earlier for possessing a stolen vehicle died in state prosecutors' custody.

media.caption: Scene from the wave of shootings and vehicle fires across Culiacán neighborhoods on the night of September 8, 2026
